This looks close to what I want, and the save/find/edit/delete flow reads right. One thing matters to me before I approve, though.

When I save a bookmark, I mostly just want to paste the link and have it figure out the page's title (and a short description) for me. Here it says I have to type the title myself and the app won't pull anything from the page. That's a big part of why I wanted this — dropping in a link and having it fill in the details is the whole convenience. Having to hand-type a title for every link would wear me down fast.

Could you make it so that when I paste a link, the app automatically grabs the page's title and description, and I can still edit them if I want? Everything else in here — tags, search, filtering, editing, and the delete-with-confirmation — is fine for a first version, so this is the one change I'm asking for before we move on.
